items.definition:
the condition of being transparent; openness
The government aims for greater transparency in its dealings.

destruction or slaughter on a mass scale, especially caused by fire or nuclear war
The museum provided a detailed account of the Holocaust.

rogue
He was a rogue who always broke the rules.

baron
The baron owned a vast estate.

power to influence a situation
The company used its market position as leverage in negotiations.

a political and economic theory of social organization
Many countries have adopted elements of socialism.

a court of justice or a judicial body
The case was heard by an international tribunal.

a line of hereditary rulers of a country
The Ming Dynasty ruled China for nearly 300 years.

a narrow valley, especially in Scotland or Ireland
We hiked through a beautiful glen in the Scottish Highlands.

a supposition or proposed explanation made on the basis of limited evidence as a starting point for further investigation
The scientist developed a new hypothesis to explain the phenomenon.

a high-ranking officer in the armed forces or a ceremonial officer
The fire marshal investigated the cause of the blaze.

a revival of something; a rebirth
The city is experiencing a renaissance in its art scene.

a long story of heroic achievement; a long, involved story or series of incidents
The family saga spanned three generations.

independence
The region is seeking greater autonomy from the central government.

a mutual relationship or connection between two or more things
There is a strong correlation between smoking and lung cancer.

friendly association, or a scholarly grant
She received a research fellowship for her studies.

the expression of one's meaning by using language that normally signifies the opposite
The irony of the situation was that the fire station burned down.

the judicial authorities of a country; judges collectively
The independence of the judiciary is crucial for a fair legal system.

a woman in a position of authority or control
The mistress of the house greeted her guests.

supreme power or authority
The country declared its sovereignty.

a sudden or violent push; the propulsive force of an engine
The rocket's powerful thrust lifted it off the ground.

prostitute (offensive)
The character was portrayed as a whore in the old novel.

the origin or mode of formation of something
The book describes the genesis of the universe.

a tax, fee, or fine
The government imposed a new levy on imported goods.

the action or fact of treating someone unfairly in order to benefit from their work
The report highlighted the exploitation of child labor.

male reproductive cells
Sperm are essential for reproduction.

the combination of components to form a connected whole
The report provides a synthesis of the research findings.

the crime of betraying one's country
He was accused of treason against the state.

an individual or body holding legal title to property for the benefit of another
The university's board of trustees met last week.

a liquid waste product
A urine sample was taken for analysis.

a detailed analysis and assessment of something
She wrote a thoughtful critique of the new novel.

written or spoken communication or debate
The political discourse has become increasingly polarized.

a wise person or an aromatic herb
The old sage offered valuable advice.

a written law
The new statute will affect all citizens.

communication over a distance by cable, telegraph, telephone, or broadcasting
The company specializes in telecommunication services.

a chief bishop
The archbishop delivered a sermon.

the murder of a prominent person
The assassination of the president shocked the nation.

a list of books or articles
The essay included a comprehensive bibliography.

(used in the phrase 'per capita') for each person
The GDP per capita increased last year.

the action of compressing or being compressed
Data compression reduces file size.

an official order or decision
The government issued a new decree regarding public health.

a substance produced by a living organism that acts as a catalyst
Digestive enzymes help break down food in the stomach.

the state or quality of being infinite
The universe seems to stretch into infinity.

an unmarried girl or young woman
The ship made its maiden voyage across the Atlantic.

a system of methods used in a particular area of study or activity
The research methodology was carefully designed to ensure accurate results.

a person who held a job or office before the current holder
My predecessor left big shoes to fill.

the action of saving or being saved from sin, error, or evil
He sought redemption for his past mistakes.

a thing that rouses activity or energy
The tax cut was a stimulus for the economy.

the muscular tube leading from the external genitals to the cervix of the uterus
The doctor explained the anatomy of the vagina.

a large body of troops ready for battle
The battalion marched towards the front line.

a strong supporter of a party, cause, or person
The debate was marked by strong partisan divisions.

the continued possession, use, or control of something
The company has a high employee retention rate.

a political theory advocating class war and leading to a society in which all property is publicly owned
The fall of the Berlin Wall symbolized the decline of communism in Eastern Europe.

the action of taking out something, especially using effort or force
The extraction of natural resources can harm the environment.

a person who makes or sells arrows
The fletcher carefully crafted each arrow for the archer.

the protective care of God or of nature as a spiritual power; timely preparation for future eventualities
They believed in divine providence. It was only by good providence that they survived.

surrounding area
There are no shops in the immediate vicinity.

a person who supports capitalism
He is a strong capitalist who believes in free markets.

a small, organized dissenting group within a larger one
The party was split into several warring factions.

a follower of fascism
The rise of fascist regimes led to World War II.

prolonged cruel or unjust treatment
The people fought against the oppression of the regime.

an organ or cell able to respond to light, heat, or other external stimulus
The drug binds to specific receptors in the brain.

a representation or depiction of something
The architect showed us a 3D rendering of the new building.

the chemical processes that occur within a living organism in order to maintain life
Exercise can boost your metabolism.
